text.tspan: Creates a new `hygiene_ratings` table, then fetches UK Food Standards Agency ratings for each restaurant,
matches results by name + postcode/city, and upserts one rating row per restaurant. It is rerun-safe (skips already
processed rows), stores confidence/status/raw payload, and includes a generated PostGIS geography column from
